tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Ink, ink-muted, ink-faint, sage-300 and accent text all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised areas: the screenshot frame's title bar, hover fill of secondary buttons. Ink, ink-muted and ink-faint read on it.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Insets and the screenshot body. Ink, ink-muted and ink-faint read on it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and frame outlines on surface-100 and sage-800. Below 3:1, so never a control border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls such as the secondary button. At least 3.2:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: sage-900
tokens.usage: Deepest sage: footers and inset panels set on sage-800. Ink reads on it.

tokens.name: sage-800
tokens.usage: Solid full-width bands (the About band). Ink reads on it at 9:1; sage-300 links at 6:1.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Window dots and small fills inside frames. Only ink reads on it; ink-muted does not.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: The eucalyptus mid-tone: rules, secondary fills and hover borders. Also readable as text on surface-100 to surface-300. Put on-sage on it.

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels, links and the brand-mark tile. Reads on surface-100 and sage-800. Put on-sage on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and every sage-700 to sage-900 ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions and secondary text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and sage-800.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, release facts and footers on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 (4.6:1 or more). Not for sage grounds.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The #fa0 splash: the primary button fill, the eyebrow dot, the wordmark's full stop, focus rings, text selection. One filled accent element per viewport.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover. on-accent text reads on it.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Primary button fill while pressed. on-accent text reads on it at 8:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-press fills (8:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sage-500 and sage-300 fills (6:1 or more).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page's single h1, in Rubik 800.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a section, in Rubik 700.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A two-sentence description of what the product does and who it is for.
styles.usage: The brief description under the h1, in Literata.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Longer passages are set in Literata, at 62 characters a line or fewer.
styles.usage: Longer passages such as the About band, in Literata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Release facts, captions and small notices, in Roboto.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and field labels. Capitalised by .sd-eyebrow.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps between icon and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and eyebrows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button side padding; gap between hero copy items.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Pill height on the cover; the screenshot title bar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns; band padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and inline code only.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Screenshot frame and the brand-mark tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the cover's blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-screen
tokens.usage: Under the screenshot frame on surface-100.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Glow under the hovered primary button only.
